data.name: Suryapriya
data.gender_notes: Suryapriya is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Suryapriya is a beautiful Sanskrit name that means 'adored by the Sun'. It is a popular name among Hindus, especially in India, where the Sun God holds immense significance in mythology and culture. The name Suryapriya carries the meaning “Adored by the Sun” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Suryapriya usually hope their child will grow to embody adored by the sun and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that evokes the warmth and energy of the Sun God, symbolizing hope, vitality, and strength.
data.etymology: Suryapriya belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Adored by the Sun.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Suryapriya total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: The Sun God, Surya, is a revered deity in Hinduism. He is believed to be the life-giver, the source of all energy, and the ruler of the day. The name Suryapriya reflects the deep respect and adoration Hindus have for the Sun God.
data.spiritual_significance: Suryapriya is a spiritual name that signifies deep devotion and love for the Sun God. It represents the innate human desire to connect with the divine source of all life and energy. The name resonates with a sense of inner peace, warmth, and positivity, reminding one of the Sun God's role as the giver of life and the embodiment of pure consciousness. Embodying the qualities of the Sun - light, warmth, and radiance - Suryapriya is a spiritually powerful name that inspires one to live with love, compassion, and purpose.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Suryapriya: Adoring the radiant Sun God. His light and warmth in our lives bring happiness and success.
